title: E-MTR-0008: exchange with stand-ins: two stand-in electrons on two fixed stand-in nuclei on the husk, solved exactly...
purpose: Experiment E-MTR-0008 in the quantum arena: exchange with stand-ins: two stand-in electrons on two fixed stand-in nuclei on the husk, solved exactly in an 8-orbital lattice basis, bind in the spatially symmetric state and not in the antisymmetric one, with antisymmetry imposed by hand; the model's own label for it, the role, is three-valued.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
